title: Compose Counts due worklist with blind-count safeguards
head: feature/stock-counts-due-demo
body:
Counts due now separates item/SKU, location, last completed count and due/class status in a responsive worklist, with the existing schedule explanation alongside it. Each row remains one item at one location. System quantities stay absent for blind counts; totals, the ten-row preview, See all and server pagination remain unchanged.

Stacked on #1176 (`feature/stock-transfers-demo`). Only the count-mode Counts due section changes; existing count case, writeoff, scanner, search and command scripts are unchanged except the new component import. A focused keyboard repair restores the originating row after a busy Start button blurs, while preserving deliberate outside focus. Two existing policy-text source assertions accept formatting whitespace without changing words or thresholds; independently reviewed under delegated technical approval.

Validation: full2230/2230 frontend, full types/lint/format and production build passed; focused13/13 and backend CycleCount8/65 passed. Actual synthetic UI Start→blind physical count→independent recount requirement passed, with self-recount unavailable. Final native focus matches the started row. Actual projection contains no count/target/history quantities while blind; See all expands10 to12 real rows. Final390/1440 light/dark captures have no overflow/JS errors and owned44/36px targets. Initial focus failure and its regression evidence are retained honestly.

Evidence and independent review: `/workspace/kpone-validation/stock-counts-due/`. This is a bounded Counts due composition, not full Stock/demo parity; unchanged case-sheet and writeoff layouts remain follow-on work. Draft only; exact-head CI required and no merge in this task.
